## Results

I retrieved the canonical UniProt entries for both human proteins and computed the masses directly from their full sequences using Biopython's `molecular_weight` (average isotopic masses), which matched the UniProt-annotated values exactly.

| Gene | UniProt | Length (aa) | Mass (kDa) |
|------|---------|-------------|------------|
| **COLEC11** | Q9BWP8 (Collectin-11) | 271 | **28.67** |
| **NRL** | P54845 (Neural retina-specific leucine zipper protein) | 237 | **25.94** |

**COLEC11** encodes the heavier protein (~28.67 kDa vs. ~25.94 kDa for NRL), a difference of ~2.7 kDa.

Note: COLEC11 is annotated as a precursor with a 1–25 signal peptide; the mature secreted chain (residues 26–271) is ~26.11 kDa. Even on a mature-chain basis it remains heavier than NRL (25.94 kDa), so the conclusion is robust to whether the signal peptide is counted.
